description: Hard state for AI agents: typed, governed, durable state with deterministic queries, governed writes, and receipts.
rules: Start with cruxible_playbill_host_create, then cruxible_playbill_init to bootstrap public principals
Write Claims and Procedures with cruxible_playbill_authoring_compile followed by cruxible_playbill_authoring_submit; the returned status names every remaining approval and activation step
A proposal is not accepted state and an approval is not activation; read accepted coordinates as state and candidate coordinates as provisional
Search for an existing Subject or Claim before minting an adjacent concept
Record contradiction as negative evidence rather than only a new positive inverse
Never request, transmit, or place a principal private key in a repository
